metadata.title: EF-REG-004 Connected receipt upload and authorized receipt access

payload.elementDescription: The medium-sized 'New Expense' navigation item in the LEFT sidebar under the EMPLOYEE section, directly below 'My Expenses' and above the MANAGER section; it is the form route, not the current detail-page heading.

payload.script: const setValue=(el,value)=>{if(!el) throw new Error('missing field'); const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) throw new Error('missing native setter'); setter.call(el,value); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}; const description=document.querySelector('input[type="text"]'); const category=document.querySelector('select'); const amount=document.querySelector('input[type="number"]'); const date=document.querySelector('input[type="date"]'); setValue(description,'EFREG004-Receipt'); if(category && category.value!=='Travel'){setValue(category,'Travel');} setValue(amount,'1250'); setValue(date,'2026-08-22'); return {description:description.value,category:category?.value,amount:amount.value,date:date.value,file:document.querySelector('input[type="file"]')?.value||''};

const el=document.querySelector('input[id$="-description"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'description field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'description setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'EFREG004-Receipt'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value,placeholder:el.placeholder};

const el=document.querySelector('input[type="number"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'amount field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'amount setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'1250'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value,validity:{valid:el.checkValidity(),min:el.min,max:el.max,step:el.step}};

const el=document.querySelector('input[type="date"]'); if(!el) return {ok:false,reason:'date field not found'}; const setter=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(el.constructor.prototype,'value')?.set; if(!setter) return {ok:false,reason:'date setter not found'}; setter.call(el,'2026-08-22'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return {ok:true,id:el.id,value:el.value,validity:{valid:el.checkValidity(),min:el.min,max:el.max}};

payload.elementDescription: The medium-sized dashed 'Upload receipt' file-input area in the CENTER-RIGHT of the New expense form, directly below the Date field and to the right of the date input; it shows a paperclip icon and the helper text 'Uploaded to the ExpenseFlow_Receipts storage bucket on submit.'

payload.script: const el=document.querySelector('input[type="file"]'); if(!el) return {found:false}; const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); return {found:true,id:el.id,rect:{x:r.x,y:r.y,width:r.width,height:r.height},display:getComputedStyle(el).display,visibility:getComputedStyle(el).visibility,opacity:getComputedStyle(el).opacity,outer:el.outerHTML,parent:el.parentElement?.outerHTML?.slice(0,1800),label:el.labels?.[0]?.outerHTML?.slice(0,1200)||null};

const input=document.querySelector('input[type="file"]'); const label=input?.closest('label'); if(!input||!label) return {ok:false,reason:'receipt label not found'}; label.click(); return {ok:true,labelText:(label.innerText||'').trim(),inputId:input.id};

payload.elementDescription: The empty single-line 'File name:' text field at the BOTTOM-LEFT of the Open dialog, directly above the file-type dropdown and to the left of the Open button; it is the field used to enter the exact synthetic receipt path.

The wide empty 'File name:' text field along the BOTTOM edge of the Open dialog, immediately to the right of the 'File name:' label and to the left of the 'Open' button; this is the native filename entry field, not the file list.

The wide single-line 'File name:' text field at the BOTTOM-LEFT of the Open dialog, immediately to the right of the 'File name:' label and directly left of the 'Open' button; this field is empty and is distinct from the file list above.

The breadcrumb location bar across the TOP of the Open dialog, currently showing the UiPath Assistant session memories path between the back/forward buttons and the Search memories box; this is the folder path control, not the file search field.

The single file-list row labeled 'efreg004-receipt.pdf' in the CENTER-LEFT of the Open dialog, directly below the 'manual-run-20260924T093500' folder row and showing an Adobe Acrobat document icon; this is the synthetic receipt file, not the folder.

The large blue 'Submit Expense' button in the BOTTOM-RIGHT of the New expense form card, directly to the right of the white Cancel button and below the selected 'efreg004-receipt.pdf' file area; this is the form submission control, not a navigation link.

payload.script: return {url:location.href, banner:(document.body.innerText||'').split('\n').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean).filter(s=>/submitted for|open the expense|dashboard/i.test(s)).slice(0,10), links:Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a=>({text:(a.innerText||'').trim(),href:a.href})).filter(x=>/open the expense|dashboard/i.test(x.text))};

payload.elementDescription: The underlined 'open the expense' link in the green success banner near the LOWER-CENTER of the New expense form, immediately after 'See it on your dashboard or' and below the receipt upload area; this link opens the newly submitted EXP-1037 record, not the Dashboard link.

The small rounded receipt button labeled 'efreg004-receipt.pdf' in the CENTER of the EXP-1037 expense detail card, on the Receipt row between the Employee and Policy rows; it has a paperclip icon and a small external/open icon, and its tooltip identifies the ExpenseFlow_Receipts bucket.

payload.script: const body=(document.body?.innerText||'').trim(); const embeds=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('embed,iframe,object')).map(el=>({tag:el.tagName,type:el.type||null,srcPresent:!!el.getAttribute('src'),dataPresent:!!el.getAttribute('data')})); const u=new URL(location.href); return {title:document.title,contentType:document.contentType,ready:document.readyState,origin:u.origin,path:u.pathname.replace(/\/[^/]*$/,'/<file>'),queryPresent:!!u.search,bodyTextLength:body.length,embeds};
